MdeditorMdeditor

Flutter 壳、Milkdown 芯的 Android Markdown 编辑器A Flutter shell around a Milkdown core, on Android

Milkdown 内核跑在 WebView 里，Flutter 只做壳，写起来是所见即所得；代码块自带高亮、行号、折叠与复制，文档能直接导出 DOCX、HTML 与 PDF。文件走 Android SAF，打开—编辑—保存始终是同一个文档 URI，每个版本由 GitHub Actions 自动打包发布。A Milkdown core inside a WebView, a Flutter shell around it — editing feels WYSIWYG. Code blocks ship with highlighting, line numbers, folding and copy, and documents export to DOCX, HTML and PDF. Files flow through Android SAF so open–edit–save keeps the same document URI, and every release is packaged automatically by GitHub Actions.

技术栈Stack

  • Flutter
  • Milkdown
  • WebView
  • Android SAF

亮点Highlights

  1. 所见即所得WYSIWYG editing

    Milkdown（ProseMirror + remark）跑在 WebView 里，标题、列表、表格、代码块即时成形，而不是纯文本加一个预览窗。Milkdown (ProseMirror + remark) runs inside a WebView — headings, lists, tables and code blocks take shape as you type, not in a side-by-side preview.

  2. 代码块完整体验Serious code blocks

    语法高亮随主题切换重建，行号、折叠与一键复制齐备，长代码也读得下去。Highlighting rebuilds when the theme switches, with line numbers, folding and one-tap copy built in.

  3. DOCX / HTML / PDF 三格式导出Exports to DOCX, HTML and PDF

    DOCX 保留代码分词高亮，HTML 带完整样式可直接分享，PDF 走 Android 系统打印。DOCX keeps tokenized code highlighting, HTML ships styled and ready to share, and PDF goes through Android system printing.

  4. SAF 文档 URI 不丢位置SAF document URIs persist

    打开—编辑—保存始终是同一个 Android 文档 URI，并持有持久化权限，重启应用接着写，不会另存出副本。Open–edit–save always targets the same Android document URI with persisted permissions — restart the app and keep writing, no stray copies.

  5. 接进系统Plugs into the system

    接收系统文件关联，从其他应用直接打开 .md；最近文件、明暗主题与字号设置一应俱全。Handles system file associations so other apps can open .md straight into the editor; recents, light/dark themes and font size settings are all there.

  6. 开箱即用的开源包Open source, ready to install

    GitHub Actions 为每个版本自动构建 APK，Releases 里直接下载；GPL-3.0 开源。GitHub Actions builds the APK for every release, ready to grab from Releases; GPL-3.0 open source.
